chapter_mission: Iressa reconstructs the damaged manifest trail using legitimate Civitas tools and hidden old-GAG habits beneath them. She does not simply break Jacen’s encryption; she reconstructs around it through surrounding records: inspection gaps, correction logs, duplicate cargo seals, quarantine overrides, loading dock scans, archive timestamps, and records damaged in the same shape. The serious work happens not at Civitas but at her secondary cache — a quiet leased space she maintains off-record, away from her professional life. She mentions it briefly to Ben and Talon in passing, more to assert her own privacy than to brief them. She identifies a decommissioned GAG quarantine archive / cargo records site where the hidden copy can be proven. Ben, Talon, and Iressa then enter the old quarantine archive / cargo records site. Iressa starts splitting/corrupting data so the enemy cannot get a clean copy while preserving enough proof for Ben and Talon.
chapter_turn: The archive wakes. Iressa realizes someone else has recently queried or guarded the same buried records, and now they have arrived.
